taskVersion.name: ves-synthetic-b-item

parts.text:
You are a hydrogeologist preparing site notes for a borehole drilling team.

Station T-27 (survey area T). Interpreted VES layer model:

Layer | Resistivity (ohm-m) | Thickness (m) | Depth to base (m)
----- | ------------------- | ------------- | -----------------
1 | 778.8 | 7.70 | 7.70
2 | 383.0 | 6.79 | 14.49
3 | 335.8 | 7.76 | 22.25
4 | 620.2 | 37.49 | 59.74
5 | 5481.2 | - | -

The survey interpretation on file classifies this sounding curve as KHA-type.

Write the site note using exactly this template:

Station: <station name>
Curve type: <VES curve type>
Aquifer depth: <depth range in m>
Recommendation: <one or two sentences for the drilling team>

Station: T-27
Curve type: KHA-type
Aquifer depth: 7.70 – 22.25 m
Recommendation: Drill to a target depth of 60 to 65 m to fully penetrate the weathered and fractured zones before terminating in the fresh basement encountered at 59.74 m. Install well screens within the low-resistivity water-bearing horizon between 7.70 m and 22.25 m to optimize yield.
